name: Sugar+Spice!
source:
The protagonist is a high school student. But, he has lost all his memories due to a traffic accident. He doesn't remember anything. In such a situation, he meets various girls, and gradually becomes closer to them...

[From Himeya Shop]
translation:
主人公是一名高中生，却因交通事故失去了所有记忆。他什么都不记得。在这种情况下，他遇见了形形色色的女孩，与她们的关系也逐渐亲密起来……

[摘自Himeya Shop]
